propositions: A new [code_health] configuration section must be defined in _config_schema.py as a typed dataclass with keys: enabled (bool, default False), scan_roots (list[str]), analyzers (dict mapping language to tool), size_cap (int or None), and size_near_fraction (float).
The code_health config section must support command-line override via -c flag (rebar -c code_health.<key>=<val>) through existing config parsing infrastructure.
The code_health section must be re-exported through config.py and integrated into the config surface contract.
The golden config surface snapshot (tests/golden/config_surface.json) must be regenerated to reflect the new section and pass the golden test validation.
This ticket defines schema only; runtime metric behavior changes and removal of hardcoded defaults in git_metrics.py are deferred to migration 0734.
